name: open.mp - Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas Server

configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that will appear in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Server Website
configurationFields.description: Sets the website people can visit to gain more information about the server

configurationFields.label: Discord Invite
configurationFields.description: Sets the address of the server discord that appears in the omp launcher

configurationFields.label: Light Banner URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL address for the server's light banner that appears in the omp launcher

configurationFields.label: Dark Banner URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL address for the server's dark banner that appears in the omp launcher

configurationFields.label: Server Logo URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL address for server's logo that appears in the omp launcher and discord status

configurationFields.label: Announce To Masterlist
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be announced to the open.mp masterlist

configurationFields.label: Enable Server Query
configurationFields.description: If set, the server's information will be displayed in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players (including bots) that may connect to the server at one time

configurationFields.label: RCON aktivieren
configurationFields.description: If set, the server's RCON will be enabled

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server's RCON. Default is a strong random password

configurationFields.label: RCON Allow Teleport
configurationFields.description: If set, RCON admins will be teleported to their waypoint when they set one

configurationFields.label: Custom Models CDN
configurationFields.description: Sets an http address for a remote model server

configurationFields.label: Enable Custom Models
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will use custom models from the directory specified under Custom Models Path

configurationFields.label: Custom Models Path
configurationFields.description: Sets the path where custom models are located

configurationFields.label: Legacy Plugins
configurationFields.description: Sets the .dll or .so files in the 'plugins' directory that the server should use to run as plugins. Plugins are scripts which are designed to enhance gamemodes and filterscripts. Don't include the file extension

configurationFields.label: Gamemodes
configurationFields.description: Sets the .amx files in the 'gamemodes' directory that the server should use to run as gamemodes. Don't include the file extension

configurationFields.label: Filterscripts
configurationFields.description: Sets the .amx files in the 'filterscripts' directory that the server should use to run as filterscripts. Filterscripts are scripts that run in the background of a gamemode, adding extras without editing the gamemode. Don't include the file extension

configurationFields.label: Component Exclusions
configurationFields.description: Sets the .dll or .so files in the 'components' directory that the server should not load. Don't include the file extension

configurationFields.label: Sleep Period
configurationFields.description: Sets how long the main open.mp and raknet networking thread will 'sleep' idly during each sync cycle. Higher values decrease server processing, but reduce sync quality, and vice versa. Don't change this unless your player count is very high and you have server FPS stability issues

configurationFields.label: Use Dynamic Ticks
configurationFields.description: If set, the server's tickrate will be kept at a constant count by using CPU more to cover the gap if there's any drop. The count is based on the Sleep Period (for example, Sleep Period of 5 = constant tick count of 200 ticks per second)

configurationFields.label: Language Display
configurationFields.description: Sets the language that appears in the server browser. Players can use this to filter servers by language in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Allow Interior Weapons
configurationFields.description: If set, the use of weapons in interiors will be allowed

configurationFields.label: Enable Chat Radius
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the Chat Radius

configurationFields.label: Chat Radius
configurationFields.description: Set a radius limitation for the chat. Only players at a certain distance from the player will see their message in the chat. Also changes the distance at which a player can see other players on the map at the same distance

configurationFields.label: Chat Input Filter
configurationFields.description: If set, the chat input filter will be enabled. Disable this setting to allow use of chars like % in the chat

configurationFields.label: Gravity
configurationFields.description: Sets the global gravity that the server uses

configurationFields.label: Group Player Objects
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will try to find a player object slot already used by another player. Since per-player and global objects share an ID pool, if unique object IDs were assigned to each player, per-player objects could not be created once the maximum global objects were reached

configurationFields.label: Lag Compensation Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the lag compensation mode. 'Enable position-only' means player rotation won't be lag compensated for

configurationFields.label: Mapname Display
configurationFields.description: Sets the mapname that appears in the server browser. This can be anything

configurationFields.label: Gamemode Display
configurationFields.description: Sets the gamemode that will be shown in the server browser. If the server has multiple gamemodes that require different gamemode texts, use the [SetGameModeText function](https://open.mp/docs/scripting/functions/SetGameModeText), which overrides this setting

configurationFields.label: Enable Player Markers
configurationFields.description: If set, enables player markers (blips on the radar)

configurationFields.label: Player Marker Draw Radius
configurationFields.description: Sets the marker radius for all players

configurationFields.label: Player Marker Mode
configurationFields.description: Sets the [player marker mode](https://open.mp/docs/scripting/resources/markermodes)

configurationFields.label: Global Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the global time that the server uses and that will be shown in the server browser

configurationFields.label: Use All Animations
configurationFields.description: If set, allows use of the animations missing from some versions

configurationFields.label: Enable Entry And Exit Markers
configurationFields.description: If set, enables all the interior entrances and exits in the game (the yellow arrows at doors)

configurationFields.label: Use Manual Engine and Lights
configurationFields.description: If set, engines will not be automatically turned on/off when players enter/exit vehicles, and headlights will not automatically come on when it is dark

configurationFields.label: Enable Nametags
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the drawing of nametags, health bars and armor bars above players

configurationFields.label: Enable Nametag Line-Of-Sight
configurationFields.description: If set, enables the Line-Of-Sight of nametags, health bars and armor bars above players

configurationFields.label: Nametag Draw Radius
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum distance to display the names of players

configurationFields.label: Use Standard Walking Animation
configurationFields.description: If set, the server uses standard player walking animation (animation of the CJ skin) instead of custom animations for every skin (such as skating for skater skins)

configurationFields.label: Enable Stunt Bonuses
configurationFields.description: If set, enables stunt bonuses for all players, so that players will receive monetary rewards when performing a stunt in a vehicle (such as a wheelie)

configurationFields.label: Enable Vehicle Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If set, enables friendly fire for team vehicles. Players will be unable to damage teammates' vehicles

configurationFields.label: Use Zone Names
configurationFields.description: If set, turns on zone/area names, such as the 'Vinewood' or 'Doherty' text at the bottom-right of the screen, as players enter the area

configurationFields.label: Validate Animations
configurationFields.description: If set, validates animations for players

configurationFields.label: Vehicle Respawn Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the vehicle respawn time

configurationFields.label: Global Weather
configurationFields.description: Sets the [global weather](https://dev.prineside.com/en/gtasa_weather_id/) that the server uses and that will be shown in the server browser. IDs above 22 can result in strange effects

configurationFields.label: Bot Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of NPCs the server can hold. Affects how many of the player slots can be used by NPCs

configurationFields.label: Log Cookies
configurationFields.description: If set, connection cookies requested by newly connecting players will be logged

configurationFields.label: Log Deaths
configurationFields.description: If set, player deaths will be logged

configurationFields.label: Log Queries
configurationFields.description: If set, all queries sent to the server by players will be logged

configurationFields.label: Log SQLite Errors
configurationFields.description: If set, sqlite DB_* function errors will be logged

configurationFields.label: Log SQLite Queries
configurationFields.description: If set, all sqlite DB_Query calls, including the query string, will be logged

configurationFields.label: Allow 0.3.7 Clients
configurationFields.description: If set, allows players with the 0.3.7 client to join the server

configurationFields.label: Cookie Reseed Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time that the connection cookie seed value updates

configurationFields.label: Grace Period For Unlimited Connections
configurationFields.description: Sets the grace period to allow unlimited connections from the same IP after starting the server,. Mainly used for NPCs

configurationFields.label: Aiming Sync Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the time that a client should update the server with new data while firing a weapon

configurationFields.label: In Vehicle Sync Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the time that a client should update the server with new data while in a vehicle

configurationFields.label: On Foot Sync Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the time that a client should update the server with new data while on foot

configurationFields.label: Player Marker Sync Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the time that a client should update the server with new data while moving

configurationFields.label: Time Sync Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the rate at which a player's game time is updated

configurationFields.label: Limits Ban Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the raknet ban time for bad connect packets, when the acks/messages limits are reached

configurationFields.label: Message Hole Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets a network level setting to deal with DoS attacks

configurationFields.label: Messages Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of messages a user can send per second

configurationFields.label: Minimum Connection Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time the server will wait before accepting another incoming connection. Don't increase from zero unless the server is suffering a connection flood attack

configurationFields.label: MTU
configurationFields.description: Recommended to keep at the default

configurationFields.label: Player Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the time after which a player will timeout when not sending any data to the server

configurationFields.label: Public Address
configurationFields.description: Sets the public IP for the server, if different to the Application IP Binding. Only used for download servers

configurationFields.label: Stream Radius
configurationFields.description: Sets the distance on the X,Y plane players will stream in server entities. Higher values makes players see server entities at a greater distance, but requires more client processing and potentially more bandwidth

configurationFields.label: Stream Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the time before the streaming in of server entities is retested for each player. Lower values increase server processing as it has to recheck streaming conditions more frequently for each player

configurationFields.label: Enable LAN Mode
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will operate in LAN mode

configurationFields.label: Use open.mp Encryption
configurationFields.description: If set, enables open.mp encryption for network traffic

deploymentSteps.name: open.mp Installation
deploymentSteps.arguments: -NoProfile -Command "Set-Location -Path 'openmp/server'; @('config.json', 'bans.json') | ForEach-Object { if (Test-Path \"$_\") { Remove-Item -Path \"Server/$_\" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } }; Copy-Item -Path 'Server/*' -Destination '.' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; Remove-Item -Path 'Server' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null"
